items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-05-10
items.q: Jimmy Spriggs was the name, but they called him Jimmy Fall Out... He was a good band at that.

ctx.x: Dude, yeah, that was a man.

Yeah. Have any alto players or a mellophone peck on, you know? I see. Well, uh, at that time, uh, Jimmy Spriggs was the name, but they called him Jimmy Fall Out. Oh, you heard about him. He went out to the Creole Syncopy. He was a good band at that. He went out on the time, Pantages time. Around New York or around the time.
Did they make much of a hit, that Creole band?

items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-01-16
items.q: Eddie Vance and Trombone and Jimmy Paul. His right name is Jimmy Spriggs, but they called him Jimmy Paul... Eddie Vance and Jimmy Paul, Big Eye Louie and Freddie Kepard.

ctx.x: We can figure it out. Who else was in the band?

I'll tell you. Eddie Vance and Trombone and Jimmy Paul. His right name is Jimmy Spriggs, but they called him Jimmy Paul. I don't know for what reason. Eddie Vance and Jimmy Paul, Big Eye Louie and Freddie Kepard. Now the other two guitar men, I can't think of who it was. Maybe you can pick that up from some other music. Did you know the bass player? The bass player? I think it was Bro. Bro, huh? I don't know which bro. They got two of them bros, you know.
You don't know which bro? There was two bros, huh? I think so.
